metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises that can help improve blood flow and circulation to your lower back.

If you're experiencing persistent back pain or dealing with an injury, this video is a must-watch. Improving circulation to the muscles supporting your lower back, as well as to the spinal discs, is key for faster healing and recovery.

In this video, we’ll cover four daily exercises that not only boost blood flow but also strengthen and protect against injury and pain.

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, try all of them and use what works best for you.

Watch now to start improving circulation to your lower back!

Link to exercise ball: https://amzn.to/3DxJWlv
